problem_statement.description: Given a sorted array of integers and a target integer, determine the index at which the target occurs. If the target does not exist in the array, return -1. The array is sorted in ascending order and each element may be assumed to be comparable with the target.
problem_statement.input: A sorted array of integers and a target integer.
problem_statement.output: The target index if present; otherwise -1.
important_conditions: The array is sorted in ascending order.

expected_algorithm.approach: Use binary search by maintaining left and right boundaries and repeatedly eliminating half of the remaining search space.
steps: If the middle element equals the target, return its index.
If the middle element is smaller, move left to mid + 1.
If the middle element is larger, move right to mid - 1.
Continue until the target is found or the search range is empty.

expected_reasoning_steps: Discard the left half when middle is smaller.
Discard the right half when middle is larger.
common_mistakes: Using binary search on an unsorted array
Infinite loops from incorrect boundary updates
Claiming O(n) or O(1) time incorrectly
